subject: Environment activation check-in — keys, peering, and allowlist timeline
messages:
From: Alex Ford <alex.ford@zenwellhealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: samira.khan@zenwellhealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP items we need to clear for environment activation

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to lock down the MAP so engineering can start validating traffic in our staging VPC. To be explicit, the items we need from Redwood to hit our internal milestones are:

- API key provisioning and instructions for rotating keys during the eval window
- Org-level setup (admin user list, service account recommendations)
- IP allowlist for our staging subnets (we'll provide the ranges)
- VPC peering steps and any required firewall rules on Redwood's side

Can you confirm a target date for these to be completed? Our launch gate is end of month; procurement also needs estimated sign-off dates.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform Engineering
Zenwell Health

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Alex Ford <alex.ford@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP items we need to clear for environment activation

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the clarity. Short answer: yes, we can deliver everything in the MAP for a staging activation. Proposed plan and timeline below (we'll coordinate with your network and security teams):

1) API keys & rotation: we will provision a scoped API key for the eval org by Jun 18. Rotation instructions and SDK snippet included.
2) Org setup: admin list and recommended service accounts by Jun 17; we can do a short walkthrough on Jun 18.
3) IP allowlist: we will provide IP endpoints and ask you to provide the CIDR list; allowlist applied same day we confirm peering.
4) VPC peering: template steps and a peering window — target Jun 22 to Jun 23 (2–3 hour maintenance window).

Action items we need from Zenwell:
- Final CIDR ranges for staging (reply to this thread)
- Confirmation of an admin contact for the walkthrough
- Preferred maintenance window for Jun 22–24

I'll pull Karthik into the thread for technical details and the VPC template. If that timeline works I will open a MAP task in HubSpot and share the DocuSign starter for procurement.

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alex Ford <alex.ford@zenwellhealth.com>, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP items we need to clear for environment activation

Alex / Priya —

Technical follow-up with specifics so your network team can validate ahead of the peering window. Attaching templates and a short checklist. Highlights:

- VPC peering: we support AWS VPC peering (cross-account) and AWS Transit Gateway. For simple staging, cross-account VPC peering is fastest. Required info: VPC ID, AWS account ID, region, and route table IDs.
- IP endpoints: Redwood will provide egress IPs for token verification and webhook callbacks (see ip_allowlist_template.csv). Expect a stable small block, rotate only on major infra changes.
- Firewall rules: allow outbound 443 to our egress range; allow inbound only if you enable webhooks.
- API keys: keys are scoped to org + project. We'll issue a temporary eval key (90-day) and include instructions for automatic rotation via our SDK.

Attachments included: vpc_peering_instructions.pdf, ip_allowlist_template.csv, map_activation_checklist.xlsx

I recommend a short pre-peering sync (30 minutes) to walk the steps — available Jun 21 or Jun 22 morning PT.

— Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
